name: Dimitrios Papadopoulos
bio:
Dimitrios developed a keen interest in motorsport finance while studying economics at the University of Athens. His early career involved working in financial analysis for a major shipping company, where he honed his skills in budget management and risk assessment. However, the roar of engines always beckoned, leading him to pursue opportunities in the racing world. Before joining Manthey EMA, Dimitrios worked for a smaller GT racing team, where he gained invaluable experience in motorsport-specific financial regulations. 

Dimitrios approaches his role with a meticulous eye for detail and a relentless drive to optimize the team's financial performance. He believes in fostering transparency and accountability in all financial matters. He is particularly adept at identifying cost-saving opportunities without compromising the team's competitive edge. What distinguishes Dimitrios is his ability to translate complex financial data into actionable insights for the team's technical and management staff, ensuring that every financial decision aligns with the overall racing strategy.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Dimitrios is of average height with a sturdy build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always has a cup of strong Greek coffee on his desk.
Keeps a spreadsheet of motorsport financial data dating back to the 1950s.
Taps his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
